entrypoints.summary: The regression runner invokes fuzz_init_b with the committed ossfuzz514727740 ELF object via --testobj.
Committed issue-specific testcase is a malformed ELF object consumed by the fuzz_init_b target.

affected_components.role: Transfers loaded group content to psh->gh_content and contained the stale local cleanup.

causal_paths.kind: ownership transfer followed by stale error cleanup

code_slices.fixed: The patch assigns data = 0 immediately after psh->gh_content = data and deletes free(data) from the gsecb error branch.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The shown error branch checks gsecb against ep->f_loc_shdr.g_count, frees grouparray, and returns DW_DLV_ERROR.
code_slices.vulnerable: After psh->gh_content = data, the local alias remained live; the gsecb bounds-error branch called free(data).

capabilities.concept: trigger duplicate release through stale ownership alias

impacts.concept: libdwarf parsing process denial of service by abort

mitigations.concept: invalidate local alias after ownership transfer

relation_candidates.dst: trigger duplicate release through stale ownership alias
relation_candidates.rationale: The documented corrupted-object testcase exposes the path where data is transferred to gh_content and then stale local cleanup occurs.

relation_candidates.dst: libdwarf parsing process denial of service by abort
relation_candidates.rationale: The case record identifies a double-free and abort/crash in the destructor after the same allocation is later freed through gh_content.
relation_candidates.src: trigger duplicate release through stale ownership alias

relation_candidates.dst: invalidate local alias after ownership transfer
relation_candidates.rationale: The exact patch sets data to zero immediately after storage in gh_content and removes the erroneous free(data) in the error branch.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of a process using libdwarf to read the crafted object.
impact.attacker_capability: An actor able to cause the program to process a crafted ELF file can trigger the documented crash; the supplied evidence does not establish code execution or other post-crash capability.
impact.security_effect: Process abort/crash while parsing a corrupted ELF object due to a double-free.

causal_trace.summary: A severely corrupted ELF object supplied to the fuzz_init_b target reaches libdwarf section-group processing.
read_gs_section_group transfers data to psh->gh_content but retains a live local data alias, allowing two cleanup paths to regard the same allocation as releasable.
On the shown out-of-range section-group branch, the pre-fix code executes free(data) after ownership has been stored in gh_content.
Later destruction frees the allocation through gh_content, producing the reported double-free abort/crash in _dwarf_destruct_elf_nlaccess.

failure.operation: free(data) on the section-group error return, followed later by destruction of gh_content

primary_invariant.statement: Once data is assigned to psh->gh_content for deferred destruction, gh_content must be the sole owner and the local data alias must not release that allocation.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix error branch frees stale local data although the allocation remains owned by gh_content and is freed later by destruction.

quality.review_notes: Maintainer case record, committed testcase, runner invocation, and exact patch support the ownership mechanism. No preserved vulnerable-build execution output, allocator/sanitizer diagnostic, or full destructor/function context is present; the testcase and runner establish a reproducer contract rather than a recorded pass/fail run.

remediation.invariant_restored: Immediately clear the local data variable after assigning it to psh->gh_content and do not free that stale alias on the error path, leaving the persistent owner as the sole eventual releaser.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Reportedly introduced earlier in May 2026; no exact introducing commit is preserved.

oracle.expected_negative: On a build containing the cited fix, the stale local release is absent after data is assigned to gh_content; this bundle contains no captured execution result.
oracle.expected_positive: On a vulnerable build, processing the committed testcase through fuzz_init_b is documented to abort/crash in _dwarf_destruct_elf_nlaccess because of a double-free.
